clue.text: Pass the fish

definitions.meaning: to ... is to pass, as time or a person passes
a small spiny-finned fish of coastal waters

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a verb phrase meaning travel past, and the name of a small sea fish.

clue.text: Understand, and see a way to beat it

parts.note: to get something is to understand it
lo is an old word meaning look or see
ST is the abbreviation for street, a way through a town

explanation.surface: Grasping a situation and spotting a route out of it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'see a way' reads as one idea, but splits into the old exclamation 'lo!' and the street abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are rude dismissals telling someone to go away at once.

clue.text: Failing to see how very drunk one is

definitions.meaning: as in ... drunk, intoxicated to the point of stupor

explanation.definitionFit: Sightlessness, and the slang sense of extremely drunk in the phrase blind drunk.

clue.text: Hunting gathering once regarded as acceptable

definitions.meaning: the assembly of riders and hounds before a fox hunt
an archaic adjective meaning fitting or proper

explanation.definitionFit: A hunt's assembly shares its spelling with an old adjective for proper or suitable.

clue.text: What you leave in the car

definitions.meaning: the property and assets a person leaves when they die
a British word for a station wagon with a rear loading door

explanation.definitionFit: A dead person's assets, and the British term for a station wagon.

clue.text: A way to complete set that's split up after a short time

indicators.note: after places the next piece behind the earlier ones in the answer

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for time
i.e. stands for id est, that is
to break is to split up

explanation.surface: A couple separate after only a brief spell together.
explanation.walkthrough: In tennis, a set level at six games is settled by a special deciding game, so the definition is a tennis one.
explanation.definitionFit: A deciding game played to settle a tennis set that is tied at six games each.

clue.text: Hub starts to fragment on car under stress

indicators.note: the opening letters of the five words that follow are taken in turn

explanation.surface: A wheel hub begins to break apart under stress on a car.
explanation.definitionFit: A hub is a centre of activity, the point where attention converges.

clue.text: Pursue a lost cause, and go to the knacker's?

definitions.meaning: to waste effort on something already settled or hopeless
flog means sell, and a knacker buys dead horses for slaughter, so selling one there

explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for futile effort, and taken literally, selling a carcass to the knacker's yard.

clue.text: Conservative interior adapted to standard

indicators.note: adapted means the letters of the word are altered into a new form

explanation.surface: A Tory's interior decoration modified to meet a standard.
explanation.definitionFit: A criterion is a benchmark or principle by which something is judged.

clue.text: Where children play with spades and diggings

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for spades in card games
a pit is a hole dug in the ground, an excavation

explanation.surface: A play area where youngsters use their spades and dig holes.
explanation.definitionFit: A box of loose grit in a playground or garden for toddlers to dig in.

clue.text: Euphoric with drink, let snake in

indicators.note: in puts the two middle pieces inside the drink

parts.note: punch is a mixed drink
leased means let, as a property
an asp is a venomous snake

explanation.surface: Someone elated by alcohol lets a snake into the house.
explanation.walkthrough: Mr Punch, the gleeful puppet of British seaside Punch and Judy shows, is the figure behind the phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means delighted, thrilled to bits, like the puppet Mr Punch.

clue.text: Group of three allowed to go on excursion

indicators.note: in an across clue, going on something means following it, so this piece comes after

parts.note: a trip is an outing or excursion
let means allowed or permitted

explanation.surface: A threesome is given permission to take a day out.
explanation.definitionFit: A trio of things, such as three verse lines rhyming together or three babies born at once.

clue.text: Feeling obnoxious in turn, having a change of heart

indicators.note: turning the word round means reading it from the end back to the start
the central letter of the synonym is swapped for another letter

parts.note: noisome means offensive or obnoxious

explanation.surface: Someone's feelings sour and then reverse, as if they had changed their mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having a change of heart' swaps the middle S of NOISOME for T, giving NOITOME, and 'in turn' reads that backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A feeling is a sentiment or passion, a state of mind such as joy or anger.

clue.text: He was a great exponent of art, seldom beaten

definitions.text: He was a great exponent of art, seldom beaten

indicators.note: beaten here suggests the letters are knocked about into a new order

explanation.surface: Tribute to a painter who was rarely bettered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beaten' rearranges ART and SELDOM; read whole, the clue describes a great painter of earlier centuries who was rarely surpassed.
explanation.definitionFit: A great European painter of the period before about 1800, or one of their works, is called this.

clue.text: With a ram around, first of ewes is preoccupied

indicators.note: the male sheep goes round the letter that follows, enclosing it

parts.note: tup is a dialect word for a ram

indicators.note: only the opening letter of the next word is used

explanation.surface: With a ram on the prowl, the leading ewe has other things on her mind.
explanation.walkthrough: TUP is a regional British word for a ram.
explanation.definitionFit: Colloquially, someone eaten up with worry or jealousy is consumed or obsessed by it.

clue.text: Hanger-on perhaps volunteers less, in retrospect

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve force

indicators.note: looking back suggests the word is read from its end to its start

explanation.surface: A clinging dependant offers less help when you look back on it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in retrospect' turns LESS into SSEL. The TA (Territorial Army) is the British army's part-time volunteer reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: A decorative tuft of threads dangles from a cushion or cap, so it literally hangs on.

clue.text: Reserved, having been a representative

definitions.meaning: already taken or claimed by someone
having talked on behalf of someone else

explanation.definitionFit: Booked or claimed, and literally having been the spokesman on another's behalf.

clue.text: Possibly plainest member of American discussion group

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters of the next word might be arranged otherwise

explanation.surface: The plainest speaker on a US talk show.
explanation.walkthrough: The single-L spelling is American, which the clue flags.
explanation.definitionFit: A participant on a broadcast panel, spelt the US way with one L.

clue.text: Note old story cropping up about previous tax system

indicators.note: about means the story goes round the letter that follows
in a down clue, coming up means the letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: a legend is a traditional old story
a. abbreviates Latin ante, before or previous
D is a musical note

explanation.surface: A recurring tale about a former levy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts A inside LEGEND (LEGENAD); D goes before, and 'cropping up' reads DLEGENAD upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The land tax raised in Anglo-Saxon England to buy off or fund defence against Viking raiders.

clue.text: Fare-dodger's stash

definitions.meaning: someone who hides aboard a ship or plane to travel without paying
to ... is to pack or hide something for later

explanation.definitionFit: A noun for a hidden passenger and a phrasal verb meaning put away out of sight.

clue.text: Sugar obtained from various sources

indicators.note: various suggests the letters take differing positions

explanation.surface: Sweetener drawn from several suppliers.
explanation.definitionFit: Sucrose is the chemical name for ordinary table sugar from cane or beet.

clue.text: A Spanish gentleman is a handsome lad

parts.note: Don is the Spanish title for a gentleman

explanation.surface: A handsome young Spaniard of good family.
explanation.walkthrough: The held clue has a stray I that the page does not print.
explanation.definitionFit: Named after the beautiful youth loved by Aphrodite, the word means any very good-looking young man.

clue.text: Painting mushrooms, used up several colour ranges

indicators.note: in a down clue, up shows the pieces are read from bottom to top

parts.note: painting is art
ceps are edible wild mushrooms

explanation.surface: A still life of mushrooms that ate up a whole palette.
explanation.walkthrough: 'used up' turns ART and CEPS together, giving SPEC then TRA.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural of spectrum, the band of colours made when light is split.

clue.text: Man and boy, he was outstandingly strong

parts.note: Sam is a man's name
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: A father and son, one of them a famed strongman.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical judge of Israel whose great strength lay in his uncut hair.

clue.text: Vulgar fellow full of energy

indicators.note: being full of something means holding it inside, so one piece contains the other

parts.note: chap is an informal word for a fellow
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A coarse man bursting with vigour.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheap can mean tawdry or in poor taste, as in a cheap joke.

clue.text: Are able to adapt or develop

indicators.note: adapt signals that the preceding letters are altered into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Able to adjust or evolve, like a flexible organism.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' looks like a link but is part of the letters; 'adapt' rearranges ARE ABLE TO.
explanation.definitionFit: To elaborate on an idea is to expand on it in more detail.

clue.text: Given nothing to eat, very keen to escape

indicators.note: eating something takes it inside, so one piece swallows the other

parts.note: avid means very keen
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Starving, eager to break free.
explanation.definitionFit: To avoid is to keep away from or evade.

clue.text: The crime committed by receiver

parts.note: of can mean done by, as in the work of someone
a fence is a criminal who receives stolen goods

explanation.surface: A theft carried out by someone who handles stolen property.
explanation.walkthrough: A receiver here is a fence, someone who buys and sells stolen goods.
explanation.definitionFit: A breach of the law; a misdeed punishable in court.

clue.text: Discover South American naval vessel abroad

parts.note: S is the compass abbreviation for south
USS stands for United States Ship, prefixed to US Navy vessel names
out can mean away or abroad, as in posted out east

explanation.surface: Locating a South American warship on foreign waters.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally, to work out or figure out the truth about something.

clue.text: Ground where Arthur's buried

indicators.note: buried means the answer lies concealed within the letters of the nearby words

explanation.surface: The spot where King Arthur lies in his tomb.
explanation.definitionFit: Soil or land, the solid surface underfoot.

clue.text: Force feed, so to speak

indicators.note: so to speak signals that the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: to dine is to eat or feed

explanation.surface: Feeding someone against their will.
explanation.walkthrough: The unit word has the same sound as the verb for eating a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A dyne is a unit of physical force in the centimetre-gram-second system.

clue.text: Thought almost perfect

indicators.note: almost means nearly all, so the synonym loses its final letter

parts.note: ideal means perfect

explanation.surface: Thinking something is very nearly flawless.
explanation.definitionFit: A notion or concept formed in the mind.
